ask.text:
YOU GATE THE PROSE OF ONE CRATE: dsse at /home/sgilda/Documents/dsse-rs.
The first standalone envelope crate in Rust. Its README will be read by people who know the specification better than we do, so every claim about the encoding must match the specification text.
FIND EVERY WORD THAT WOULD BE PUBLISHED. THE REGISTER FOR A CRATE README IS DEVELOPER DOCUMENTATION. Second person, active voice, present tense, sentence-case headings, conditions before instructions, and requirement words used precisely. No superlatives and no unverifiable performance claim; a number in a README carries where it was measured.

budget.basis: hand-set: policy. A release body is a NOTICE, not a comment: it says what changed, what to verify and how, so it is longer than any thread channel and shorter than a filing. The v0.10.1 notes measure 292 prose words and would have been refused under the 90-word listing-pr band. The tables, the fenced verification blocks and the corpus table are already outside the count, because `send_prose` strips fences and table rows for every channel. No corpus of release bodies is on disk, so this is a policy number.

rows.reason: The finding's own text calls this 'a multi-section paper'. It is a 696-word crate README. The academic floor of 0.1 cross-references per 1,000 words licenses 0.07 of one at this length, so no value of the axis above zero is reachable without inventing a pointer between sections a reader scrolls past in one screen.

rows.reason: All three rows (lint-p79-1f23c2c18dc9, lint-p79-186be46c0385, lint-p79-29f46f2c228a) point at one two-column markdown table whose rows mirror a structure in the code: six refusals, one per row, each with a distinct Error variant in src/error.rs and a test that fails without it, and the second column carries the reason for that one refusal. Rewriting six paired values as prose would lose the pairing the reader came for.

rows.description: absolutes-self-contradiction: 'never' — ADVISORY (absolutes lexicon): absolute claim word — every hit must be ledger-adjudicated, never batch-dismissed. Verify no hedged variant of the same claim exis
rows.reason: The one occurrence of 'never' is 'it orders verification attempts and never excludes a key'. No hedged variant of that claim exists anywhere in the document: 'excludes' occurs once in 696 words and the hedge tokens usually, generally, in general, normally, typically, almost, mostly and often occur 0 times in the file. The code makes the same unhedged claim, in src/verify.rs, where every entry is tried after the hinted one.
